images.name: you-dont-need-to-bike-to-bike-fast-1
images.joke: You didn't even love her Jake! You won't get away with this... / And...Scene.
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God stands on a red-curtained stage between thrown tomatoes, pointing and shouting: "You didn't even love her Jake! You won't get away with this..." A cartoon director at the edge says: "And...Scene."

images.name: you-dont-need-to-bike-to-bike-fast-3
images.joke: Reasons Jake Boyce was faster: 1. He stole the love of my life! (crossed out) 1. Cycling training made him fitter
images.alt: Chalkboard titled "Reasons Jake Boyce was faster": "He stole the love of my life!" is crossed out and replaced by "1. Cycling training made him fitter." Cartoon Gravel God's head looks on from the corner.

images.name: you-dont-need-to-bike-to-bike-fast-4
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God stands beside a pink 1967 Mustang with its hood up, red dots on his chest and legs, and arrows labelled "Central" (to the engine) and "Periphery" (to the wheels).

images.name: you-dont-need-to-bike-to-bike-fast-5
images.joke: 2. He's a terrible human being (crossed out) 2. Jake was happy training. I hated it.
images.alt: The chalkboard list grows: "He's a terrible human being" is crossed out, replaced by "2. Jake was happy training. I hated it." Cartoon Gravel God's head grimaces in the corner.

images.joke: But NO SNOWSHOEING! ANYTHING BUT THAT.
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God's head thinks: "But NO SNOWSHOEING! ANYTHING BUT THAT." Beside him, a pair of yellow snowshoes in the snow is crossed out with a big red X.
